author: Kyud3n
body:
What make you feel weak? not enough survivability, or not enough damages?

For damages your stuff is ok for T8, but it would be nice to see the spells you're using. Are you buffing yourself with Bear's might, warcry, golem fortitude and barrier 2 when doing gauntlets? what is your main DPS skill ? Also, what does you Amity do ?

You can also change of spec. I would recomend Bard for Warrior's Dance.

AND i see your passive buff (crest of lyonesse) is only charged at 20%, you must try to have it a 100% all time.

author: killerkillers
body:
You should probably get a new specialization. The one you currently are is a tier 5 specialization, and there are more powerful ones available at tier 7.

Depending on your playstyle, bard can give you a good damaging skill (Warrior's Dance), Ranger is a straight upgrade to Hunter, Zweifencer is good if you have some good two handed weapons lying around..

author: TacticalMicrowav3
body: Many good suggestions so far, you are in T8 so my only add would be to farm a good Avalon crown from the kingdom raid, best base att value and a good number of adornment slots and curse and petrification immunity. Along with the Heimdall's shield for stun immune and a ring of annwnn (for paralysis immune) you can get immunity from some of the more annoying turn denial debuffs
